title_zh: 統合分析：AI 對話代理對大學生憂鬱與焦慮的效果
title_en: Efficacy of AI-driven conversational agents for mental health promotion among university students: a systematic review and meta-analysis
summary_zh: 系統性回顧與統合分析，納入以大學生為對象的 AI 對話介入隨機對照試驗。與低強度或非主動對照比較時，對憂鬱（3 項比較，Hedges g≈-0.41）與焦慮（4 項比較，g≈-0.44）有小至中等的正向效果；與主動對照（MYLO）比較則未見可靠的額外效果。作者強調證據基礎仍小、異質性高。
summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs of AI-mediated conversational interventions in university students. Against low-intensity or non-active comparators, small-to-moderate benefits for depression (k=3, g≈-0.41) and anxiety (k=4, g≈-0.44); no reliable added effect against an active conversational control (MYLO). The authors stress the small, heterogeneous evidence base.
evidence_note: 系統性回顧與統合分析（納入 RCT）；效果量來自作者報告的主要分析
caution: 效果多來自非主動對照，對主動對照無額外效果；證據小且異質。AI 對話工具不能取代危機處理與正式臨床服務。
brief_zh: 依 PRISMA 式流程篩選 3,294 篇獨特紀錄，最終納入 RCT 進行因果統合
效果只在非主動對照下顯著，對主動對照無額外效果
證據仍少且異質，不宜視為已證實的臨床替代方案
supervision_questions: 學生若在 AI 聊天工具中提及自傷或危機，學校與臨床服務的轉介流程如何接上？
AI 介入與主動對照的差異，對我們選擇推介哪種服務有什麼啟示？

related.title_zh: 統合分析：情緒取向治療（Greenberg 系 EFT）對成人憂鬱、焦慮與 PTSD 的療效
related.title_en: Meta-analysis of emotion-focused therapy for adult distress disorders
related.summary_zh: 這篇 2026 年 4 月刊於 Psychotherapy Research 的統合分析，針對 Greenberg 系的情緒取向治療（Emotion-Focused Therapy，個人與團體形式，排除伴侶 EFT），納入 13 篇試驗（EFT 組 348 人、對照 201 人）。EFT 相對於無治療對照效果大（g = 1.39），相對於其他既有心理治療的優勢則小（約 0.28）。作者同時指出研究品質普遍偏低、有出版偏誤跡象，樣本也集中於女性與白人或伊朗參與者。
related.summary_en: A 2026 meta-analysis in Psychotherapy Research of 13 trials of (Greenberg-style) emotion-focused therapy, excluding couples EFT, found a large effect versus inactive controls (g = 1.39) and a small advantage over active therapies (about 0.28). The authors flag poor study quality, publication bias and narrow samples.

related.title_zh: 統合分析：聊天機器人對憂鬱、焦慮症狀有小到中等效果，臨床族群最明顯
related.title_en: Chatbot meta-analysis for depression and anxiety
related.summary_zh: npj Digital Medicine 刊出的系統性回顧與統合分析納入 39 篇 RCT，聊天機器人對憂鬱（g=0.31）與焦慮（g=0.28）症狀有小到中等的改善。臨床族群效果（g=0.64）明顯大於非臨床族群（g=0.07）；生成式與檢索式聊天機器人之間未見顯著差異，但生成式研究數量少、檢定力可能不足。
related.summary_en: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 39 RCTs in npj Digital Medicine found small-to-moderate effects of chatbots on depressive (g=0.31) and anxiety (g=0.28) symptoms. Effects were larger in clinical samples (g=0.64) than nonclinical ones (g=0.07); no significant difference was found between generative and retrieval-based chatbots, though generative studies were few.

related.title_zh: 首個 EFIT 隨機對照試驗：Sue Johnson 系情緒取向個人治療用於憂鬱與焦慮
related.title_en: First RCT of emotionally focused individual therapy (EFIT)
related.summary_zh: 這篇研究介紹整理 Wiebe、Sue Johnson、Tasca 等人 2025 年於 Psychotherapy 發表的隨機對照試驗：88 位有憂鬱與焦慮的成人隨機分派接受約 15 次情緒取向個人治療（EFIT，屬 Sue Johnson 的 Emotionally Focused Therapy 體系，非 Greenberg 的 EFT）或候補名單。相較候補組，EFIT 組的憂鬱與焦慮顯著下降，情緒調節與心理福祉也有改善；研究在 COVID-19 期間進行。
related.summary_en: A practitioner write-up of Wiebe, Johnson et al. (2025, Psychotherapy): 88 adults with depression and anxiety were randomised to ~15 sessions of emotionally focused individual therapy (EFIT) or waitlist; EFIT reduced depression and anxiety and improved emotion regulation.
